scenarios.subject: Following Up from the SEO Career Summit
scenarios.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thank you for the conversation at the SEO Career Summit in New York. I enjoyed hearing more about Morrow & Pike's programs, and it was great to learn we're both from Atlanta and both Duke alums (well, I'm still working on that part!).

My name is Maya Okafor, and I am a sophomore at Duke University studying Economics, graduating in May 2029. This past summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for dividend stocks used in client portfolio reviews, and I currently cover the consumer sector for the Duke Investment Club. Between the two, I've become especially interested in consumer and retail M&A.

I had two questions, if you have a moment. First, when does the sophomore program at Morrow & Pike typically open for applications? Second, does that program feed directly into the summer analyst class, or is it a separate track?

My resume is attached. Thank you again for your time at the summit!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
maya.okafor@duke.edu
(919) 555-0142
